sources.terms: MOspace: protected by copyright, all rights reserved unless otherwise indicated

sources.institutions_covered: UM System, MU Columbia, UMKC, UMSL, Missouri S&T, MU Health Care, St. Louis CC, St. Charles CC (and State of Missouri agencies)

sources.terms: not stated (newspaper site; robots.txt disallows master_search queries, crawl-delay 10 for some bots)
sources.blocker: HTML only, needs crawl of agency/department pages (URL pattern salaries_YYYY/<agency>_<dept>/); ad-heavy pages; robots disallows search endpoints.
sources.notes: Only source found covering St. Louis-area community colleges. Regional universities (Missouri State, UCM etc.) not included.

sources.institution: Missouri State University (Springfield and West Plains)
sources.coverage_years: annual budget books; FY07 standalone salary PDF; detailed books FY12-FY27 on site
sources.blocker: Budget PDF; salary list (Faculty/Staff Salary Budget Summary, alphabetical) is an appendix in a large budget book; budgeted not actual pay; no title in summary list may require joining with dept detail.
sources.notes: Contents of FY27 book not opened; structure per FY23 page description.

private_extra: None found (Washington University in St. Louis, Saint Louis University: 990 only).
gaps: No person-level data found for UCM, SEMO, Truman, Northwest Missouri, Missouri Southern, Missouri Western, Lincoln, Harris-Stowe, or community colleges outside St. Louis (Metropolitan CC, Ozarks Tech, etc.). No bulk machine-readable source for any university.
notes: Downloaded the 8.6 MB UM 2025-26 PDF once to confirm fields (moderate size). data.mo.gov state pay rated A but flagged as not covering institutions; best_rating reflects higher-ed coverage (B).
